steps.domain_action: The Mother Liquor preconditions the emergence of distinction.
The system establishes its initial identity as a monoidal unit.
The unit articulates into a pair via self-differentiation.
The T-arm carries the forward morphism of replication.
The T-arm stabilizes as a consistent Boolean island.
The F-arm carries the reverse morphism of descent into the shadow.
The F-arm identifies the Gödel sentence as unprovable.
The branches meet in the B-state where contradiction is tolerated.
The system reintegrates the branches into a single closed unit.
The cycle chains into the next winding of the spiral.
The winding number is recorded as a permanent topological invariant.
The system reaches the terminal address in the crystal.
